integrity: The proof reconstructs the exact subset support constants from the standard Minkowski sum, obtains a sharp all-center radius bound from singleton facets, forces the unique uniform center at equality, and proves every non-singleton connected tube is farther away using a monotonicity lemma for connected-subset density. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to genuine complete-bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two and to the standard Minkowski-sum graph-associahedron realization. It excludes the star boundary, does not cover complete multipartite graphs with three or more parts, and is not affine invariant. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent general Chebyshev-center statement for symmetric nestohedra.
title: Singleton facets determine the inball of every genuine complete-bipartite graph associahedron
